VOID: produced from the pre-revision reviewer answers, because the agent runner reuses an answer file already on disk; the answers are archived under agents/rev1_evidence/ and it is not evidence of the reconciled proposal

numbering_defect: the revision number was computed from decision.json only, so the second re-review wrote decision_rev2.json again and overwrote the void revision-2 record; latest_snapshot() and an existence check now read the highest revision on disk and refuse to overwrite any completed record
